notes.title: Update v1.0.0
notes.content:
(This patch note is fully machine-translated. We apologize for any awkward phrasing, but due to the volume of content we could not finish human translation in time.)

ShapeHero Factory has now reached its official release (v1.0.0).
We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has played the game and provided feedback during its development.
We hope you continue to enjoy ShapeHero Factory moving forward.

This update marks a major milestone as we transition to the official release version.
We have addressed many of the issues that have been raised, made balance adjustments, and added new content. As a result, please note the following:

Any in-progress run data from versions prior to 1.0.0 will no longer be compatible and cannot be resumed.

For the first clear only, when you complete an Ex Stage, you will not be able to proceed to Endless Mode.
This is to maintain compatibility with the new unlock timing for Endless Mode introduced in the official release.

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

Main Updates in this Version

Added Ex Stages and conditions to access them.

Added up to Ascension 9. Adjusted the content and order of each Ascension.

Adjusted Mana so that its initial value and growth rate increase with each Ascension.

Added a new system: Statues and Tablets.

Added Shops to events on the Incursion Route.

Greatly revised the content of Surprise Events.

Adjusted overall level design:

Relic rewards can now be chosen from two options.

Research Trees can now be reloaded for 20 Keen.

Gaining a level now grants +1 Keen.

Knockback mechanics revised: enemies gradually gain resistance after repeated knockbacks until they are fully immune. In return, knockback is now effective against more enemy types.

Burn mechanics revised: Burn can now stack, dealing damage over time based on stack count.

Adjusted overall Hero parameters, abilities, and behaviors.

Expanded Medusa’s petrification targets and added a “take increased damage” effect against petrified enemies.

Strengthened late-wave enemies:

Minions (Complete Form) HP increased to ~2.3×.

Adjusted Boss and Named enemy behaviors:

Adjusted the size of certain Named enemies.

Added 1 new Research Tree, changed 11, and removed 1.

Rebalanced all Research Trees; most became stronger overall. One research that could not be balanced was removed.

Basic Research Tree improved to be more usable from the start and scale stronger.

Higher-tier Bridge Conveyors added to the General Research Tree, making them easier to use.

Universal Ink Converter and Universal Motif Converter unlocked via Arcane Knowledge can now be used from the start without spending Research Points once unlocked.

Added 29 new Relics, removed 3, and revised many others.

Weak or undesirable Relics were adjusted or removed, rarities rebalanced, and with the larger pool, Relic rewards can now be chosen from two options.

Added 5 new pieces of Arcane Knowledge, changed 2.

Introduced “Consumable Items,” which are not permanent unlocks but single-use items.

Added 3 new high-difficulty Achievements.

Improved UI visibility:

Adjusted placement and size for better readability.

Added an Option to enlarge UI size.

Further optimized processing load:

Improved ink-related factory processing.

Reduced overall battle processing load.

Prevented excessive spawning of some Heroes/Spells when battles are already overwhelmingly in the player’s favor.

Fixed performance issues when opening certain UI for the first time.

Added bulk Conveyor Belt replacement:

When hovering over a Conveyor with another Conveyor held, holding Left Click will upgrade or downgrade it. (Future update will extend this to Splitters and Mergers.)

Expanded Options:

Added a setting to always display port priority guides (input/output) for Splitters and Mergers.

Added an Option to enlarge UI size.

Revised Controller operations:

Separated camera and cursor movement for improved control.

Added fast cursor movement in battle.

Improved inventory cursor movement behavior.

Full support for Steam Deck.

Various bug fixes:

Minion Master’s direct attack damage now displayed in battle results.

Fixed incorrect output direction when using Filters.

Fixed slow production speed in Candy Warehouse.

Clarified ambiguous text like “Number of Shots” / “Number of Bullets.”

Clearly indicated when Relics or Hero Abilities also affect Spells.

Fixed issues where some Relics or Hero Abilities did not function properly.

Fixed incorrect attack ranges for some Heroes.

Fixed some Hero attacks occasionally not hitting.

Fixed Conveyor speed sometimes not applying correctly.

Improved save data timing to reduce unnecessary writes.

Fixed bug where Treant’s Bleed damage kept increasing indefinitely.

Fixed bug where item counts did not update correctly when opening the Inventory.

notes.title: ShapeHero Factory Version 1.0.0 is now live🏭✨
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


We are excited to announce that ShapeHero Factory has officially left Early Access and is now available as a FULL RELEASE!

Thanks to the incredible feedback from our community, we’ve made major strides to bring exciting updates to the game.
We can’t wait for you to feel how much more polished and fun it has become.
Let's dive in and explore all the new features waiting for you!


1️⃣ New: EX Stages
EX Stages are unlocked by clearing specific 'Trials' during a run. The ultimate challenge is to clear an EX Stage on Ascension 9!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/b41a3301a2db9757b447aca89b29252a67e30324.gif"]
Note regarding Endless Mode:
After the launch of version 1.0, the requirement to unlock Endless Mode will change to: clearing an EX Stage. 
If you play an EX Stage using save data from Early Access where Endless Mode has already been unlocked, please note that due to compatibility adjustments, you will not be able to access Endless Mode upon your first clear of an EX Stage. 
Starting from your second EX Stage clear, Endless Mode will function as intended without any issues. 
Thank you for your understanding!


2️⃣ More Ascensions!
Speaking of the ascensions, the system has been expanded to Level 9!
Ascension 9 is extremely challenging, requiring carefully constructed builds to succeed!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/2731b2a5f1148f0d69367a5ba04e65603cfb904c.gif"]
3️⃣ New: Statues & Tablets
Hero Statues and Spell Tablets are new facilities exclusively used for synthesis! 
When you choose "Upgrade" in a hero recipe reward, you will also receive the corresponding Statue. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/9543fb05939d28295c8173def4f906051d10cb04.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/3ff7cd2d74eff6fe7343e92f11aaa192bd9f86a6.png"]
4️⃣ New: Shop system
A new event tile, the Shop, now appears along the incursion route!
Here, you can spend Carats to purchase various items![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/5058dd1d25e67e0546df363c4e9e5c4492f1b5e3.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/d163ee9d6c71526d221652bb588589201274bf9b.png"]

5️⃣ Expanded Strategy Systems⭐️ Research Tree Overhaul
 New additions: 1

 Adjustments: 11

 Removed: 1

Basic researches are easier to use from the start, while general researches that felt weak or impractical have been strengthened! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/4187a61063c95d3e7578733660b131004a82cccb.png"]
⭐️ Relics Expanded
Relics are no longer scarce! Many new relics have been added, while some were merged, removed, or rebalanced. 
Even familiar relics may now have new effects or broader applications!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/3effb3fb04c5f44317b6dbb4f615b954d8e5d40f.png"]

⭐️ Arcane Knowledge Additions
The long-requested feature to make use of leftover Arcane Knowledge Points has finally been implemented!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/0eaaff1a849ac63187acdb8a5414f835afc25642.gif"]

⭐️ Happenings Rebuilt
Most old events have been redesigned from scratch! 
The new Happenings are more rewarding while also enabling bold and unusual strategies when conditions are favorable!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/793007a50084c98d69bd60e9ea7c49a796d41686.png"]

6️⃣ Console launches & Optimizations
ShapeHero Factory is expanding to different consoles!
To make this possible, we invested significant time in optimization. 
This also applies to the Steam version, so the performance that used to feel heavy has now been vastly improved. 
The game should now feel far more stable and comfortable to play! 


7️⃣ Refreshed Level DesignOverall balance has been adjusted so that enemies scale more steeply in the later stages, increasing tension and raising the rewards for victory!


These are the highlights of what you will find in the full release of ShapeHero Factory!
We want to thank every player who provided feedback during Early Access. Your input has been vital in shaping the game into its current form. 

Now, get your factories ready, refine your strategies, and prepare to tackle the challenges that await you in version 1.0.0!

notes.title: 3️⃣ Days until 1.0 Launch! What’s Changing? - Statues & Tablets
notes.content:
Only 3 days left until the launch of ShapeHero Factory ver. 1.0!Today, we're introducing the brand-new Statues & Tablets system!


The "Hero Statues" and "Spell Tablets" are new equipments designed specifically for synthesis. 

Simply place a statue in your desired location, and you will create an instant Replica generator!🏭✨

This Replica can be used for synthesis only, and they cannot fight in the tower defense🗿

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/9543fb05939d28295c8173def4f906051d10cb04.png"]

The production speed of these statues is influenced by the base production speed of the corresponding hero. 

Once a statue is placed, it cannot be removed without a pickaxe⛏️


⭐️How to get them
When you select "Upgrade" as a hero reward, you will now also receive the corresponding statue.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/3ff7cd2d74eff6fe7343e92f11aaa192bd9f86a6.png"]



This system directly addresses feedback regarding higher-tier heroes. 

We have received several requests for a method to evolve heroes without sacrificing their abilities or disrupting existing factory setups. 

Using this feature enables you to produce higher-tier heroes without destroying the production line of the lower tiers!💪

Plus, it minimizes the space required to prepare hero components, making it very time, cost, and space-efficient✨



That’s all for today!

Tomorrow, it’s time to turn up the heat...
More Ascensions!🕯️😈
New levels, tougher enemies!

Get ready to test your limits!

notes.title: Update v0.10.2
notes.content:
Updated to v0.10.2

In this update, we focused on improving performance during Endless Mode, which has been our highest priority. Compared to previous versions, the processing load during battles has been reduced to approximately 50%. We will continue working on further improvements.
In the next update, we plan to adjust the content of Endless Mode—such as allowing new Hero Recipes to appear occasionally—and refine hero behavior logic. These changes will reflect feedback from the community as we continue to improve overall game balance. We will also accelerate the update pace, and we appreciate your continued support.

[Adjustments]
・Some performance issues during battles, especially in Endless Mode, have been partially improved. 
・Weakened the boss "Naga".This adjustment was made because "Naga" was significantly harder to defeat compared to other bosses, except with specific heroes.
・Adjusted unlock order within the Research Tree "Recycle Tech".
・Added license information to the Credits.

notes.title: Major Update v2
notes.content:
Updated to v0.10.0.

Here we are with the 2nd Major Update.
This update brings the highly anticipated Endless Mode (β). Please keep in mind that this mode is currently in beta for two reasons:

1. We wish to refine this content with your feedback, guiding us toward its final form.
2. We've identified some performance concerns. As gameplay progresses, the processing load may increase, which could impact the playability. We appreciate your patience as we resolve these issues in upcoming updates.

In addition to Endless Mode, we've also received requests to extend the total number of waves. This is something we are considering addressing as well. For now, we will first monitor the performance of Endless Mode before deciding whether to increase the number of waves further.
We truly appreciate your feedback and look forward to hearing your thoughts.

[Added]
・Introduced Endless Mode (β), available after unlocking it at "Arcane Knowledge."
・Added a scoring feature; scores are now displayed in the record view.
・Adjusted the content of the Research Tree "Recycle Tech": removed the "Inserter" and added the new equipment "Shredder".
・Introduced a new Research Tree titled "Inserter Tech," where the "Inserter" is now accessible.
・Added "Big Composite Divider" and "Giant Composite Divider" to the Research Tree "Layout Hub".
・Included "Composite Cross Conveyor" in the Research Tree "Pipe Infrastructure," and removed "Reverse Pipe."
・Added an option to prevent gameplay speed from resetting to default at the start of a battle.

[Adjustments]
・Adjusted to display HP when hovering over the HP bar.
・Revised the Inventory UI for better differentiation between the Favorite tab and other tabs.
・Added an unlock animation for new equipment obtained from the Research Tree.

[Hardware Support]
・Added support for 16:10 resolution.
・Enabled controller support.
・Enabled Steam Deck support.
・Enabled Mac support. (Controller not supported on Mac)

[Bug Fixes]
・Fixed an issue where Ink would not flow correctly when Bridge Pipes were placed consecutively.

notes.title: First Major Update!
notes.content:
Updated to v0.9.0
The major version has finally gone up a notch!
This time, we've added three new bosses and introduced a brand-new game mode.

Challenge Mode offers a different set of rules compared to the usual gameplay, giving you a fresh way to enjoy the game. We hope you'll give it a try.
We've also improved the ink-related mechanics based on your feedback, addressing many of the concerns you've raised.

We'll continue making improvements based on your voice, so please keep the feedback coming. Thanks for your continued support.

[Added]
・Added new bosses to Stage 1: "Naga" and "Gladius."
・Added new boss to Stage 2: "Golem."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/397b580ae6ce527401d08ecff6297ec6bd9ef0f5.png

・Added Challenge Mode.
　-Added new Challenge:  "Cramped Scroll" and "All-Out Brawl." 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/8dbdd3c578b7688fd79e4d1a2adf4b05b8645500.png

・Added new research trees: "Development of White Ink" and "Pipe Infrastructure."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/3ded89d86a22fc730ae23749cf733dcce7cd8104.png

・Added an "Inventory" button to view the list of owned equipment. (Shortcut settings are also available.)
・Added a button to save factory screenshots in the play record. 
　-Once saved, they can be viewed in the play log, just like in the previous version.
・In the Field Guide, the conditions for obtaining relics and research trees with prerequisites have been added.

[Adjustment]
・The mechanics of ink-related equipment have been overhauled. 
　-The operation of ink-related equipment, such as the Mixer, has been changed to be more intuitive than before.
　-Additionally, we have added effects for ink shortages and detailed information about the equipment.
・Adjusted the production speed of several ink-related equipment upwards and made minor adjustments to the content of the research tree.
　-Improved the Ink Engine.(The initial dropper now allows up to three Ink Engines to operate per unit.)
　-Adjusted the initial Ink Conversion Efficiency of the Mixer. (70% → 50%)
・Adjusted the mechanism of the Inserter so that it can now directly input and output to production facilities. 
　-As a test implementation, there are conditions on the input/output positions.
・Adjusted the specifications of Ascension 5 "Mini-bosses will be added to boss fights."
　-In line with the increase in bosses, the system has been updated from randomly selecting one to selecting a Named from the route.
・Adjusted the Hero added to the Field Guide to be always visible in the Hero Tree as well.
・Adjusted the event on the Incursion Route to display the amount of resources gained.
・Adjusted several unclear text displays.

[Bug Fixes]
・Fixed an issue where heroes would get stuck when sent from two directions to the four corners of the portal.
・Fixed an issue where the conveyor would stop when placed next to the Minion Snack Shack.
・Fixed an issue where the shortcut for the Palette Tab would not work.

We are excited to announce a long-awaited MAJOR UPDATE🙌🎉

The first update is scheduled for Friday, February 28th JST
Seven more sleepless nights until the reveal
For those of you eager for more details, we are pleased to introduce 
three key features of this major update:

1.Challenge Mode
This mode will challenge your strategy to win a battle with the enemies in a set condition! 
This mode activates after you complete the Normal mode with both “Minion Master” and 
“Spell Master” once each.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114224/8dbdd3c578b7688fd79e4d1a2adf4b05b8645500.png

Cramped Scroll
As the name implies, the scroll cannot be expanded during the factory build. 
This tests your decision-making skills to build the most effective factory in a limited space!

All-Out Brawl
The battle does not end until either your portal or the enemy force gets wiped out!
All Hero Recipes will be available for selection from the beginning of the battle; 
however, one component—the Motif Source—will be available only in limited quantities 
at the beginning. Fight your way through battles to earn ◯△⬜︎ Motif Sources in a special 
Incursion Route! Understanding the features of each hero becomes more crucial than ever 
to conquering challenging enemies with higher status!
*All-out Battle requires players to meet specific conditions to participate,

"Naga" appears to hatch some sort of egg.
And what exactly does a "Golem" do...?

One moment of gameplay must be worth a thousand words
Try out the newest update and see it for yourself!

3. New Research Tree & Spell “Sanctuary”
We are excited to announce the addition of two new research trees related to pipes!
In addition, we introduce you to a brand new “White Ink”, along with exclusive equipment!
With this new ink, you will be able to produce the 10th spell, "Sanctuary."

We cannot wait to showcase the beautifully finished visual effect of this spell, 
which we have been longing to reveal to you all!

In addition to the major updates explained above, other balance adjustments will be made 
based on your feedback.

Furthermore, we will continue expanding Challenge Mode content and introducing even more 
exciting updates in the future!
Please stay tuned for those as well.

Minions and we look forward to seeing you at the ShapeHero Factory on February 28th JST👍

notes.title: Update v0.8.10
notes.content:
Updated to v0.8.10

This update primarily focuses on balancing Mythic Beasts and improving convenience. Since Mythic Beasts were generally stronger than Warriors, we have adjusted them primarily through nerfs.
Additionally, we had planned to implement Challenge Mode in this update, but development is taking longer than expected, so we have decided to postpone it to February. The core framework is already complete, so we appreciate your patience a little longer.

[Added]
・Added a favorite feature to the play log.
・Added a profile feature. (You can switch profiles using the button in the upper right corner of the title screen.)

[Adjustments (Battle)]
・Significantly revised the Hero Abilities of Rank D and Rank C Mythic Beasts.
・Nerfed Black Dog.
・Nerfed Salamander.
・Adjusted Mandrake.
・Adjusted Harpy.
・Nerfed Meteor, Wyvern, and Dragon (Reduced the Burn application value).
・Standardized the effect of slowing down enemy movement speed as the "Slow" trait for some Heroes, and adjusted its effectiveness.
・Significantly nerfed Frost Laser and added a Slow effect (It was extremely powerful due to a configuration mistake).
・Optimized the action logic of some Heroes when there are enemies affected by Burn.

[Adjustments (Others)]
・The introduction movie at the start of the game can now be skipped with a click.
・Made minor changes to the wording in the Ascension details.
・The enlarged display of screenshots in the history has been removed (to reduce save data size).

[Bug Fixes]
・Fixed an issue that occurred when initializing save data.
・Fixed a bug where the visual effect range did not change when some heroes gained the ability to increase their area of effect.
・Fixed an issue where some heroes would move towards empty areas with no enemies.
・Fixed text inconsistencies.

notes.title: Update v0.8.7
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for playing Shapehero Factory and for your interest in the game.
Currently, the development team is focusing on balancing overall resources, balancing between heroes, balancing between warriors and mythical beasts, and fixing bugs.

As the first step, we have made adjustments to the balance of overall resources and the ranks D and C of warriors.
The first change is the adjustment of mana acquisition balance. In general, it has become easier to obtain mana in the early stages. Additionally, we have made it possible to acquire mana immediately upon leveling up, which expands your options.
The second change is the actual increase in the timing of obtaining hero recipes, making it easier to acquire higher-tier hero recipes at an earlier stage.
The third change is the downward adjustment of abilities for lower-tier heroes (mythical beasts will be addressed later). Their hero abilities were very powerful, which led to imbalance.

In addition, various other fixes have been made.
We will continue to improve the game step by step, so please continue to enjoy Shapehero Factory.

notes.title: About ShapeHero Factory's future plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Today, we would like to update you with our grand schedule for ShapeHero Factory!
We are afraid we could only give out a portion of the information, but we could still share the anticipation together!

Demo version!
We are planning to offer a free demo on Steam very soon!
Our team is working hard to have it ready by Steam Next Fest this June. Stay tuned!
More information will be provided as soon as it is confirmed.

Regarding the release date
We have been developing the game for quite a time now, but we are aiming even higher!
Therefore, we have made a decision to edit the release date from Q1 2024 to Q3 2024.
We are truly sorry for everyone who has been looking forward to the launch.
However, we wish that you could take this as our challenge to take our game to the next level.
Hopefully a demo scheduled on June would feed your appetite for a good indie game a little longer.

We are exhibiting at "TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2024"!
The event will finally take place next weekend!
This will be the first time since Tokyo Game Show 2023, for us to share you our progress in Japan.
